_readme: SHARED platform repos — one instance for ALL clients, not per-customer. Per-client repos (ETL, config) live in customers/<CLIENT>/repos.json.
_sync: Before reading platform source on a ticket, sync each local clone to the latest `branch`: `git -C <local> fetch origin <branch> && git -C <local> checkout <branch> && git -C <local> pull --ff-only`. Skip (and say so) if the clone has local changes. Cite the synced commit SHA in evidence.

frontend.note: React/TS monorepo, config-driven UI (AG Grid). Same build serves every tenant; behavior differs by config, not code. `dev` is the main branch.

backend.note: Java (Maven). Executes pivots, serves config, builds filter options, member resolution. `dev` is the main branch. See knowledge/backend/darwin-primer.md.
